start.dialog: People are losing time! Not memories—actual hours disappearing from their lives! They go to bed, wake up, and it's three days later! A time thief is draining temporal energy! Track them before they steal someone's entire lifetime!
start.objective: Investigate the missing time reports and track the time thief

progress.dialog: The thief is a rogue Chronomancer! He's hiding in a pocket dimension, siphoning time from unsuspecting victims! You need to breach his sanctuary and stop the ritual—if he completes it, he'll become immortal at the cost of thousands of lives!
progress.objective: Breach the Chronomancer's pocket dimension and stop his ritual

complete.dialog: The Chronomancer is apprehended, the stolen time returned! His victims wake up with no memory of the lost days, but they're alive! The Temporal Guard offers you this Time-Thief's Shackles! They nullify time magic on the wearer!

party_comments.kade: A guy stealing time? That's the worst kind of theft there is!
party_comments.twist: He wanted immortality. I showed him eternity in a cell instead.
party_comments.nix7: Temporal larceny: prevented. Justice: served across all timelines.
